items.name: Rocky Mountain Warm-Up 2023
items.information:
We're excited to welcome competitors back to Erie for another fun day of speedcubing!

Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. These tabs include important information regarding your responsibilities as a competitor and are very important!


This competition has a 100 competitor limit. Please try to limit your guests that you bring to the competition!
Competitions fill quickly, so it is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, this video will provide you with most of the information you need.https://youtu.be/dPL3eV-A0ww
If this is your first competition, please be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:10 AM.
If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team, to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete. You will receive a 75 percent refund if you drop before the withdrawal deadline of (02:00 UTC 10-21-2023)
This competition is financially supported by Colorado Cubers!

venue.name: [Associação Guarda Mirim de Londrina](https://goo.gl/maps/9ZW6wvsDKiq8wzY36)
venue.address: R. Orestes Medeiros Pulim, 94 - Bairro Aeroporto, Londrina - PR, 86038-010
venue.details: **Pátio central**, seguindo reto no corredor após a entrada. Haverá sinalização no local.

items.information:
##### 🇧🇷
O **Pé Vermelho 2023** é um campeonato **aberto** e **beneficente**. Aqui estão algumas instruções e lembretes para quem pretende participar:

* Todas as informações sobre inscrição no evento podem ser encontradas na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PeVermelho2023/register).
* As inscrições vão até o dia **20/10/2023**, ou até que o **limite de 50 competidores** seja atingido. Após essa data, só será possível a inscrição no dia do campeonato, caso haja vagas remanescentes.
* Chegue ao local da competição, com seu cubo em mãos, no mínimo 30 minutos antes do horário de qualquer modalidade que você participará.
* É necessário que todos os participantes leiam o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição.
* O cubo com o qual você vai competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele. Caso contrário, o cubo pode não ser aceito para a competição.
* Caso seja seu primeiro campeonato, assista [este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EFKDwkhPJJE).
* Não há idade mínima ou máxima para participação, mas competidores menores de 18 anos só podem participar com a presença de um responsável legal.
* Todos os competidores devem apresentar documento válido com foto no credenciamento!
* Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. Mande seus questionamentos para a [organização](diego.quintanilha@hotmail.com) e faremos o melhor possível para ajudar. Sempre há espaço para novos competidores!
* Divirta-se!

---

##### 🇺🇸
**Pé Vermelho 2023** is an **open charity** competition. Here are some instructions and reminders for those who wish to participate:

* All information regarding registration can be found in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PeVermelho2023/register) tab.
* Registration closes on **10/20/2023**, or whenever the **limit of 50 competitors** is reached. After that, it will only be possible to register for the 3x3x3 Cube event, in the day of the competition, if there are still vacancies.
* Be present at the competition venue, in possession of your cube, at least 30 minutes earlier for any event you are participating.
* All participants must read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.
* The cube with which you will compete must be in good condition, so take good care of it. Otherwise, your cube may not be approved for the competition.
* If this is your first competition, watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EFKDwkhPJJE).
* There is no minimum or maximum age for participation, but underage competitors can only participate with the presence of a legal guardian.
* All competitors must present a valid document at the check-in.
* If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. You can e-mail your questions to the [organization](diego.quintanilha@hotmail.com), and we will do our best to help you. There is always room for new speedcubers!
* Have fun!

---

This competition is in a series with [Pickering Fall A 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PickeringFallA2023). You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted and registration fees will not be transferred across competitions. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand for competitions in southern Ontario and are regularly planning and announcing more competitions. Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

# ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaGxIIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e1a87d9563999f890af638f98836b63b2aac90c5/6u.png) Español 

Hay un límite de 100 competidores para el registro.

* Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes.
* Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución.
* **COMPETIDORES NUEVOS**: deben leer [Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NacionalesUruguayas2023#29292-importante-read) y [Competidores nuevos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NacionalesUruguayas2023#29293-competidores-nuevos-newcomers).
* A las **PERSONAS QUE VIAJEN DESDE LEJOS** se les recomienda leer [Alojamiento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NacionalesUruguayas2023#31708-alojamiento-accommodation).
* Se debe tener en cuenta que los competidores pueden ser descalificados en los casos que prevé el Reglamento de la WCA. No se realizan reembolsos de ningún tipo por descalificación, según el artículo [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles.
* Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la ronda, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento.
* Es importante leer toda la información disponible en la página de la competencia.

Ante cualquier duda consultar a los organizadores o a los delegados de la WCA.

***
# ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaHBIIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bacb00caed7d0c9177dc3ea7d687667b270ce30d/6i.png) English 

Competitor limit: 100.

* Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue.
* This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age.
* **NEW COMPETITORS**: You must read [Important](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NacionalesUruguayas2023#29292-importante-read) and [New competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NacionalesUruguayas2023#29293-competidores-nuevos-newcomers).
* We recommend **PEOPLE TRAVELING FROM FAR AWAY** to read [Accommodation](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NacionalesUruguayas2023#31708-alojamiento-accommodation).
* Note that competitors may be disqualified under the circumstances described in the WCA Regulations. A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition, as per regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Competitors must bring their own puzzles.
* Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations.
* It is important to read all the information available in the competition website.

Feel free to contact the organizers or the WCA Delegates.

## Ontario Favourites Fall 2023 Series

This competition is in a series with [Pickering Favourites Fall 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PickeringFavouritesFall2023). You will only be able to compete in ***one*** of these two competitions. ***Attempting to register for both competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.***

### Registration Reminders

Since this is a "favourites" competition, **you may choose at most five (5) events**. 

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted and registration fees will not be transferred across competitions. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

### Mailing List

We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand for competitions in southern Ontario and are regularly planning and announcing more competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

### Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

venue.name: Carlmont High School
venue.address: 1400 Alameda De Las Pulgas Belmont CA 94002

items.information:
First competition held in Belmont, CA!

* Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.
* Competitors may only bring one guest maximum.

**Competition Day Timing**
- The competition will begin at the scheduled start time.
- Lunch will end at the scheduled time. 
- Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. 
- Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.
## Competitors are limited to ONE guest. Spectators who are not associated with a registered competitor will NOT be permitted to enter the venue.
